items.statement: Determine whether a methoxy-associated change in molecular polarity is attributable to intramolecular hydrogen bonding, the substituent's electronic contribution, or the conformational population. Use the supplied EPI1/EPI2 fragments and interventions capable of distinguishing these explanations. Relate polarity evidence to hydroxyl geometry and vibrational response.
items.expected: The conclusion follows the complete same-object control matrix, evaluated hypotheses and demonstrated sensitivity. Accept support, refutation or bounded ambiguity when justified by real results; do not force the author claim. A missing expanded calculation is a missing endpoint, not computed ambiguity. Numerical publication anchors apply only to like-defined source baselines and never substitute for new reference calculations. Avoid these scientific errors: Changing fragment truncation; using arbitrary-frame vector cancellation; treating a restrained point as an equilibrium minimum; calling a single dipole or an unvalidated constrained vibration a proof of bulk dielectric behavior.
